reply_text:
I've replied to Pree in the DM thread. I only searched the channels and shared files she can see herself.

- **West yard Door 2 double-booking:** Tobias raised it in #central-random on Oct 13. He said it still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. Nothing has been posted since, so there's no fix, owner or ETA on record. He was talking about "his dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks, so I suggested she check with Tobias that it's the same account before adding it to the file.
- **Driver SMS prompt glitch on overflow lots:** I found nothing in her channels or the shared files, and there's no Marrow Fieldworks folder in the share. I told her that plainly and suggested she ask Tobias or support.
- **Not the same account:** I also pointed out that the Marrow threads in #central-team (ticket PD-4821 and the Pine Crossing missing-shift issue) are about Marrow Agrisupply, not Fieldworks.
